messages:
alex: Heads-up team: we need a short release-note blurb + migration snippet for the new rollout-by-traffic feature in routing (canary by percentage). Also add one known-issue about stale client cache causing 404s on the new /routing/rollouts endpoint. Target: site deploy tomorrow AM.
rebecca: Drafted a two-line blurb and pushed a PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1601. Blurb says: 'Added rollout-by-traffic for routing policies: define percent splits for model variants to enable gradual rollouts.' Kept it short for the release notes page.
omar: I'll add the SDK migration snippet. Important: SDKs <0.11.0 don't expose the percent API and will 404. Also note that the REST endpoint changed from /routing/drafts -> /routing/rollouts for active configs.
rebecca: Good catch. Can you add a tiny JS example showing the new API call and a curl example for ops?
omar: Added to PR: 
```js
// SDK >=0.11.0: create a traffic rollout (10% variantB)
client.routing.createRollout({
  name: 'canary-variantB',
  splits: [{variant: 'variantB', percent: 10}, {variant: 'variantA', percent: 90}]
})
```
omar: And curl: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routing/rollouts -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"name":"canary","splits":[{"variant":"variantB","percent":10}]}'
```
kevin: For the known-issue note, let's be explicit: customers with old client caches (cached OpenAPI spec) may get 404 on the new endpoint. Recommend clearing spec cache or upgrading SDK. I added a one-line troubleshooting pill in the PR.
rebecca: I also added a short troubleshooting FAQ entry: how to check if you hit the old endpoint (look for 404 with message "routing.drafts not found"). Keep it one sentence.
alex: Docs-CI can you preview the PR and check redirects and anchor links? Need to ensure the rollout docs appear under /releases/routing-rollouts and that examples render.
docs-ci: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-1601--docs.redwood.ai (rendered: /releases/routing-rollouts). Lint and link-check passed. Redirects for /routing/drafts -> /routing/rollouts tested (302).
omar: Tiny addition: show how to read rollout metadata in the response so customers can log percent values. Small JSON snippet added to PR: 
```json
{"name":"canary-variantB","splits":[{"variant":"variantB","percent":10},{"variant":"variantA","percent":90}],"status":"active"}
```
kevin: Also added a short note recommending Dedicated customers to use dedicated pools for deterministic rollout timing (one-liner).
rebecca: Can folks react with :shipit: if okay? Plan to merge after final CI run and cut site deploy at 07:00.
omar: :shipit: small nit fixed in PR comments.
kevin: :shipit: verified examples render correctly.
docs-ci: Final build green. Merge complete. Site deploy scheduled for 07:00.
alex: Thanks team. I'll add the release bullet to the release-notes doc and flag product for the announcement. Closing thread. :wave:
